claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Epic Boon is a permanent level-up reward with no activation, no resource pool, and no reset cadence. The sole existing ClassFeatureMechanics family ('activation') requires all three of activationCost + resource + resetCadence. None apply here. A new family is needed for features that permanently grant something at level acquisition — no expenditure, no refill.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The sole effect of Epic Boon is acquiring a feat permanently. No ClassFeatureEffect variant covers this: grant_extra_action is a per-turn combat action grant; heal_hp is HP restoration. The v4 atom inventory has grant_proficiency and grant_spell_access but no grant_feat.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Fate is recommended.
